description: Find a specific car, truck, SUV or van for sale near the user, new or used, from live dealer inventory. Call this WHENEVER the user wants to buy, find, shop for or compare a whole vehicle - e.g. '2019-2021 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid under $28k near 07030', 'used Honda Civic 2018 or newer under 18k in Atlanta', 'F-150 4x4 with low miles near me'. Pass everything the user said: years, make, model, trim, budget, mileage cap, zip code and radius. Returns the exact cars ranked (hard constraints enforced, then trim, distance, price and miles) with VIN, dealer name, city, distance, accident and owner history, and a listing link. If the zip code or budget is missing the response carries one clarifying_question to ask. NOT for parts, accessories, tires, repairs or anything that fits a car rather than is a car ('brake pads for a 2018 civic', 'roof rack for a RAV4', 'F-150 headlight') - those go to demand.search.

body.description: sedan, suv, truck, coupe, hatchback, minivan, van, wagon, convertible

client_ref.description: Optional stable, non-identifying reference for this end user (any opaque string; we hash it). Lets us count repeat askers without knowing who they are.

condition.description: "cpo" is manufacturer certified pre-owned. "any" searches all three; omitting it does not exclude used cars.

fuel.description: gas, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, electric, diesel

make.description: Manufacturer, e.g. "Toyota". Optional - it is parsed from `query` when omitted. Pass it only to override what the text says.

model.description: Model line, e.g. "RAV4 Hybrid". Optional; parsed from `query` when omitted.

price_max_cents.description: Budget ceiling in cents. $35,000 is 3500000. Enforced as a maximum.

query.description: The user's request in their own words, e.g. '2020 or newer Chevy Silverado 4x4 under $35k near 75201'

trim.description: Trim level, e.g. "XLE". Narrows hard, so omit unless the buyer named one.

year_max.description: Latest model year to accept, inclusive. Omit for "2019 or newer".

year_min.description: Earliest model year to accept, inclusive. Four digits.

zip.description: 5-digit US zip code to search near (required for local results)

name: demand.find_vehicle

go_url.description: Tracked link to the listing; prefer this when showing a link

title: Find a specific car from live dealer inventory
